`README.md`:

```md
# PowerAC

PowerAC is a local Minecraft anti-cheat focused on detecting AIM modules and aim-assist style cheats.

The neural network runs **entirely inside the plugin** (pure Java, no external server, no license key).
It analyses rotation telemetry in 64-sample windows and flags suspicious aim behaviour.

## Model files

All model files live in the plugin data folder (`plugins/PowerAC/`):

- `rotation.json` - the neural network (feature scaler, convolution/MLP weights, aggregation thresholds).
  A pre-trained model is bundled with the plugin and copied here on first start.
- `rotation_replay.json` - labelled training windows collected with `/powerac train` (created on demand).

## Training

The model can be fine-tuned in place, without any external service:

```text
/powerac train <legit|cheater> [true|false]
/powerac train <player> <legit|cheater> [true|false]
/powerac train stop [player]
/powerac train clear
```

Collect a batch of legit data and a batch of cheater data, and the plugin retrains and hot-swaps
the model automatically. Training runs asynchronously and never blocks the server thread.

## Commands

```text
/powerac player <name>            - player info
/powerac alerts                   - toggle alerts
/powerac monitor [player]         - live AI probabilities in the action bar
/powerac status                   - local model status
/powerac train ...                - train the local model
/powerac reload                   - reload config
```

## Author

Developed by `katze225 (tg @core2k21)`.

## License

Please read `LICENSE.md` before using, modifying, or distributing this source code.

```

```
#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015-2021 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH="\\\"\\\""


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        -jar "$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!

if %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1
if not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%
exit /b %EXIT_CODE%

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega

```java
package me.katze.powerac;

import co.aikar.commands.BukkitCommandManager;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEvents;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEventsAPI;
import io.github.retrooper.packetevents.factory.spigot.SpigotPacketEventsBuilder;
import lombok.Getter;
import me.katze.powerac.ai.RotationModelManager;
import me.katze.powerac.api.PowerACApi;
import me.katze.powerac.api.PowerACApiImpl;
import me.katze.powerac.command.PowerACCommand;
import me.katze.powerac.manager.ConfigManager;
import me.katze.powerac.manager.DiscordWebhookManager;
import me.katze.powerac.manager.FileLogManager;
import me.katze.powerac.manager.PerformanceManager;
import me.katze.powerac.manager.PlayerManager;
import me.katze.powerac.packet.BrandCapturePacket;
import me.katze.powerac.packet.ConnectionPacket;
import me.katze.powerac.packet.EspPacket;
import me.katze.powerac.packet.TrackerPacket;
import me.katze.powerac.scheduler.PlatformTaskScheduler;
import me.katze.powerac.scheduler.TaskHandle;
import me.katze.powerac.scheduler.TaskSchedulers;
import me.katze.powerac.task.PerformanceTask;
import me.katze.powerac.task.ResetVLTask;
import org.bstats.bukkit.Metrics;
import org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin;

@Getter
public class PowerAC extends JavaPlugin {

    private PacketEventsAPI<?> packetEvents;
    private PlayerManager playerManager;
    private BrandCapturePacket brandCapturePacket;
    private ConnectionPacket connectionPacket;
    private TrackerPacket trackerPacket;
    private EspPacket espPacket;
    private BukkitCommandManager commandManager;
    private PowerACApi api;
    private ConfigManager configManager;

    @Getter
    public static PowerAC instance;

    private TaskHandle vlClearTask = TaskHandle.NO_OP;
    private TaskHandle performanceTask = TaskHandle.NO_OP;
    private FileLogManager fileLogManager;
    private DiscordWebhookManager discordWebhookManager;
    private RotationModelManager rotationModelManager;
    private String pluginVersion;
    private PerformanceManager performanceManager;
    private PlatformTaskScheduler taskScheduler;

    @Override
    public void onLoad() {
        packetEvents = SpigotPacketEventsBuilder.build(this);
        PacketEvents.setAPI(packetEvents);
        PacketEvents.getAPI().load();
    }

    @Override
    public void onEnable() {
        instance = this;

        saveDefaultConfig();
        configManager = new ConfigManager(this);

        fileLogManager = new FileLogManager(this);
        discordWebhookManager = new DiscordWebhookManager(this);
        performanceManager = new PerformanceManager(this);
        taskScheduler = TaskSchedulers.create(this);
        reloadSettings();
        pluginVersion = getDescription().getVersion();

        rotationModelManager = new RotationModelManager(this, configManager.getModelSettings());
        if (configManager.getModelSettings().autoLoad) {
            rotationModelManager.reload();
        }

        getLogger().info("==================================================");
        getLogger().info("PowerAC - local AI anti-cheat");
        getLogger().info("author: katze225 (@core2k21)");
        getLogger().info("telegram: https://t.me/core2k21");
        getLogger().info("discord: https://discord.gg/zewRxfEANC");
        getLogger().info("==================================================");
        logMissingGrimAC();

        new Metrics(this, 26396);

        brandCapturePacket = new BrandCapturePacket();
        playerManager = new PlayerManager(this, brandCapturePacket);
        brandCapturePacket.setPlayerManager(playerManager);
        api = new PowerACApiImpl(this, playerManager);
        connectionPacket = new ConnectionPacket(this, playerManager);
        trackerPacket = new TrackerPacket(playerManager);
        espPacket = new EspPacket(this);

        PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().registerListener(connectionPacket);
        PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().registerListener(brandCapturePacket);
        PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().registerListener(trackerPacket);
        PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().registerListener(espPacket);
        PacketEvents.getAPI().init();

        commandManager = new BukkitCommandManager(this);
        commandManager.registerCommand(new PowerACCommand(this, playerManager));

        reloadTasks();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDisable() {
        vlClearTask.cancel();
        vlClearTask = TaskHandle.NO_OP;
        performanceTask.cancel();
        performanceTask = TaskHandle.NO_OP;
        if (trackerPacket != null) {
            PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().unregisterListener(trackerPacket);
        }
        if (espPacket != null) {
            PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().unregisterListener(espPacket);
        }
        if (brandCapturePacket != null) {
            PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().unregisterListener(brandCapturePacket);
        }
        if (connectionPacket != null) {
            PacketEvents.getAPI().getEventManager().unregisterListener(connectionPacket);
        }
        PacketEvents.getAPI().terminate();
        commandManager = null;
        api = null;
        fileLogManager = null;
        discordWebhookManager = null;
        if (playerManager != null) {
            playerManager.shutdown();
        }
        rotationModelManager = null;
    }

    private void logMissingGrimAC() {
        if (getServer().getPluginManager().getPlugin("GrimAC") != null) {
            return;
        }

        getLogger().warning("<--->");
        getLogger().warning("GrimAC was not found on this server.");
        getLogger().warning("Rotation checks will continue to work, but GrimAC is still recommended for movement/world protection.");
        getLogger().warning("GrimAC: https://modrinth.com/plugin/grimac");
        getLogger().warning("<--->");
    }

    private void reloadTasks() {
        if (playerManager == null) {
            return;
        }

        vlClearTask.cancel();
        vlClearTask = TaskHandle.NO_OP;
        performanceTask.cancel();
        performanceTask = TaskHandle.NO_OP;

        if (configManager.getVlClearIntervalSeconds() >= 0) {
            long intervalTicks = configManager.getVlClearIntervalSeconds() * 20L;
            vlClearTask = taskScheduler.runGlobalTimer(
                new ResetVLTask(playerManager),
                intervalTicks,
                intervalTicks
            );
        }
        if (performanceManager != null) {
            performanceTask = taskScheduler.runGlobalTimer(
                new PerformanceTask(performanceManager),
                100L,
                100L
            );
        }
    }

    public void reloadSettings() {
        configManager.reload();
        if (performanceManager != null) {
            performanceManager.reload();
        }

        if (fileLogManager != null) {
            fileLogManager.reload(
                configManager.isLogsEnabled(),
                configManager.getDeleteLogsAfterDays()
            );
        }
        if (discordWebhookManager != null) {
            discordWebhookManager.reload();
        }
        if (playerManager != null) {
            playerManager.reloadChecks();
        }

        reloadTasks();

        if (rotationModelManager != null) {
            rotationModelManager.applySettings(configManager.getModelSettings());
            rotationModelManager.reload();
        }
    }

    public String getPrefix() {
        return configManager.getPrefix();
    }

    public boolean isConsoleAlerts() {
        return configManager.isConsoleAlerts();
    }

    public String getPlayerLimitKickMessage() {
        return configManager.getPlayerLimitKickMessage();
    }

    public boolean isBlockSuspiciousBrands() {
        return configManager.isBlockSuspiciousBrands();
    }

    public String getSuspiciousBrandKickMessage() {
        return configManager.getSuspiciousBrandKickMessage();
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/Conv1d.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

public final class Conv1d {

    public final int inChannels;
    public final int outChannels;
    public final int kernel;
    public final int padding;
    public final float[] weight;
    public final float[] bias;

    public Conv1d(
        int inChannels,
        int outChannels,
        int kernel,
        int padding,
        float[] weight,
        float[] bias
    ) {
        this.inChannels = inChannels;
        this.outChannels = outChannels;
        this.kernel = kernel;
        this.padding = padding;
        this.weight = weight;
        this.bias = bias;
    }

    public Conv1d copy() {
        return new Conv1d(inChannels, outChannels, kernel, padding, weight.clone(), bias.clone());
    }

    public int parameterCount() {
        return weight.length + bias.length;
    }

    public float[] forward(float[] input, int time) {
        int width = time + 2 * padding;
        float[] padded = new float[inChannels * width];
        for (int c = 0; c < inChannels; c++) {
            System.arraycopy(input, c * time, padded, c * width + padding, time);
        }

        float[] output = new float[outChannels * time];
        for (int o = 0; o < outChannels; o++) {
            int outOffset = o * time;
            float biasValue = bias[o];
            for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
                output[outOffset + t] = biasValue;
            }
            int weightOffset = o * inChannels * kernel;
            for (int c = 0; c < inChannels; c++) {
                int paddedOffset = c * width;
                int weightBase = weightOffset + c * kernel;
                for (int k = 0; k < kernel; k++) {
                    float w = weight[weightBase + k];
                    int sourceOffset = paddedOffset + k;
                    for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
                        output[outOffset + t] += w * padded[sourceOffset + t];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return output;
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/Gelu.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

public final class Gelu {

    private static final float SQRT_2 = (float) Math.sqrt(2.0d);

    private Gelu() {}

    public static float erf(float x) {
        float sign = x < 0f ? -1f : 1f;
        float ax = Math.abs(x);
        float t = 1f / (1f + 0.3275911f * ax);
        float y =
            1f -
            (((((1.061405429f * t - 1.453152027f) * t) + 1.421413741f) * t -
                0.284496736f) *
                t +
                0.254829592f) *
            t *
            (float) Math.exp(-(double) ax * (double) ax);
        return sign * y;
    }

    public static float apply(float x) {
        return 0.5f * x * (1f + erf(x / SQRT_2));
    }

    public static void applyInPlace(float[] values) {
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            values[i] = apply(values[i]);
        }
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/GroupNorm1d.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

public final class GroupNorm1d {

    public static final float DEFAULT_EPSILON = 1e-5f;

    public final int groups;
    public final int channels;
    public final float epsilon;
    public final float[] weight;
    public final float[] bias;

    public GroupNorm1d(
        int groups,
        int channels,
        float epsilon,
        float[] weight,
        float[] bias
    ) {
        this.groups = groups;
        this.channels = channels;
        this.epsilon = epsilon;
        this.weight = weight;
        this.bias = bias;
    }

    public GroupNorm1d copy() {
        return new GroupNorm1d(groups, channels, epsilon, weight.clone(), bias.clone());
    }

    public int parameterCount() {
        return weight.length + bias.length;
    }

    public void forwardInPlace(float[] values, int time) {
        int channelsPerGroup = channels / groups;
        int elementsPerGroup = channelsPerGroup * time;
        for (int g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
            int groupOffset = g * elementsPerGroup;
            double sum = 0d;
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsPerGroup; i++) {
                sum += values[groupOffset + i];
            }
            double mean = sum / elementsPerGroup;
            double variance = 0d;
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsPerGroup; i++) {
                double diff = values[groupOffset + i] - mean;
                variance += diff * diff;
            }
            variance /= elementsPerGroup;
            float inverse = (float) (1d / Math.sqrt(variance + epsilon));
            for (int c = 0; c < channelsPerGroup; c++) {
                int channel = g * channelsPerGroup + c;
                float channelWeight = weight[channel];
                float channelBias = bias[channel];
                int channelOffset = channel * time;
                for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
                    int index = channelOffset + t;
                    values[index] =
                        (float) ((values[index] - mean) * inverse) * channelWeight +
                        channelBias;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/Linear.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

public final class Linear {

    public final int inFeatures;
    public final int outFeatures;
    public final float[] weight;
    public final float[] bias;

    public Linear(int inFeatures, int outFeatures, float[] weight, float[] bias) {
        this.inFeatures = inFeatures;
        this.outFeatures = outFeatures;
        this.weight = weight;
        this.bias = bias;
    }

    public Linear copy() {
        return new Linear(inFeatures, outFeatures, weight.clone(), bias.clone());
    }

    public int parameterCount() {
        return weight.length + bias.length;
    }

    public float[] forward(float[] input) {
        float[] output = new float[outFeatures];
        for (int o = 0; o < outFeatures; o++) {
            int offset = o * inFeatures;
            float acc = bias[o];
            for (int i = 0; i < inFeatures; i++) {
                acc += weight[offset + i] * input[i];
            }
            output[o] = acc;
        }
        return output;
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/RotationModelFile.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

import com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader;
import com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken;
import com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.Writer;

public final class RotationModelFile {

    private RotationModelFile() {}

    public static void write(RotationModel model, Writer writer) throws IOException {
        RotationNet net = model.getNet();
        AggregationConfig aggregation = model.getAggregation();
        JsonWriter json = new JsonWriter(writer);
        json.setLenient(true);
        json.beginObject();
        json.name("format").value(RotationNet.FORMAT);
        json.name("input_dim").value(net.getInputDim());
        json.name("window_size").value(net.getWindowSize());
        json.name("hidden_dim").value(net.getHiddenDim());
        json.name("total_samples").value(net.getTotalSamples());
        writeArray(json, "feature_mean", net.getFeatureMean());
        writeArray(json, "feature_std", net.getFeatureStd());
        json.name("aggregation").beginObject();
        json.name("decision").value(aggregation.decision);
        json.name("suspicious").value(aggregation.suspicious);
        json.name("ratio_gate").value(aggregation.ratioGate);
        json.name("top_fraction").value(aggregation.topFraction);
        json.name("mean_weight").value(aggregation.meanWeight);
        json.name("median_weight").value(aggregation.medianWeight);
        json.name("top_boost").value(aggregation.topBoost);
        json.name("spread_penalty").value(aggregation.spreadPenalty);
        json.endObject();
        json.name("layers").beginArray();
        writeConv1d(json, net.getConv1());
        writeGroupNorm(json, net.getNorm1());
        writeConv1d(json, net.getConv2());
        writeGroupNorm(json, net.getNorm2());
        writeConv1d(json, net.getConv3());
        writeGroupNorm(json, net.getNorm3());
        writeLinear(json, net.getLinear1());
        writeLinear(json, net.getLinear2());
        writeLinear(json, net.getLinear3());
        json.endArray();
        json.endObject();
        json.flush();
    }

    private static void writeArray(JsonWriter json, String name, float[] values) throws IOException {
        json.name(name).beginArray();
        for (float value : values) {
            json.value(value);
        }
        json.endArray();
    }

    private static void writeConv1d(JsonWriter json, Conv1d conv) throws IOException {
        json.beginObject();
        json.name("type").value("conv1d");
        json.name("in").value(conv.inChannels);
        json.name("out").value(conv.outChannels);
        json.name("kernel").value(conv.kernel);
        json.name("padding").value(conv.padding);
        json.name("weight").beginArray();
        for (int o = 0; o < conv.outChannels; o++) {
            json.beginArray();
            for (int c = 0; c < conv.inChannels; c++) {
                json.beginArray();
                int base = (o * conv.inChannels + c) * conv.kernel;
                for (int k = 0; k < conv.kernel; k++) {
                    json.value(conv.weight[base + k]);
                }
                json.endArray();
            }
            json.endArray();
        }
        json.endArray();
        writeArray(json, "bias", conv.bias);
        json.endObject();
    }

    private static void writeGroupNorm(JsonWriter json, GroupNorm1d norm) throws IOException {
        json.beginObject();
        json.name("type").value("groupnorm");
        json.name("groups").value(norm.groups);
        json.name("channels").value(norm.channels);
        writeArray(json, "weight", norm.weight);
        writeArray(json, "bias", norm.bias);
        json.endObject();
    }

    private static void writeLinear(JsonWriter json, Linear linear) throws IOException {
        json.beginObject();
        json.name("type").value("linear");
        json.name("in").value(linear.inFeatures);
        json.name("out").value(linear.outFeatures);
        json.name("weight").beginArray();
        for (int o = 0; o < linear.outFeatures; o++) {
            json.beginArray();
            int base = o * linear.inFeatures;
            for (int i = 0; i < linear.inFeatures; i++) {
                json.value(linear.weight[base + i]);
            }
            json.endArray();
        }
        json.endArray();
        writeArray(json, "bias", linear.bias);
        json.endObject();
    }

    public static RotationModel parse(Reader reader) throws IOException {
        JsonReader json = new JsonReader(reader);
        json.setLenient(true);

        int inputDim = 10;
        int windowSize = 64;
        int hiddenDim = 512;
        long totalSamples = 0L;
        float[] featureMean = null;
        float[] featureStd = null;
        AggregationConfig aggregation = AggregationConfig.defaults();

        Conv1d[] convolutions = new Conv1d[3];
        GroupNorm1d[] normalizations = new GroupNorm1d[3];
        Linear[] linears = new Linear[3];
        int convolutionIndex = 0;
        int normalizationIndex = 0;
        int linearIndex = 0;

        json.beginObject();
        while (json.hasNext()) {
            String name = json.nextName();
            if ("input_dim".equals(name)) {
                inputDim = json.nextInt();
            } else if ("window_size".equals(name)) {
                windowSize = json.nextInt();
            } else if ("hidden_dim".equals(name)) {
                hiddenDim = json.nextInt();
            } else if ("total_samples".equals(name)) {
                totalSamples = json.nextLong();
            } else if ("feature_mean".equals(name)) {
                featureMean = readFloats(json, inputDim);
            } else if ("feature_std".equals(name)) {
                featureStd = readFloats(json, inputDim);
            } else if ("aggregation".equals(name)) {
                aggregation = readAggregation(json);
            } else if ("layers".equals(name)) {
                json.beginArray();
                while (json.hasNext()) {
                    json.beginObject();
                    String type = null;
                    int in = 0;
                    int out = 0;
                    int kernel = 3;
                    int padding = 1;
                    int groups = 8;
                    int channels = 0;
                    float[] weight = null;
                    float[] bias = null;
                    while (json.hasNext()) {
                        String field = json.nextName();
                        if ("type".equals(field)) {
                            type = json.nextString();
                        } else if ("in".equals(field)) {
                            in = json.nextInt();
                        } else if ("out".equals(field)) {
                            out = json.nextInt();
                        } else if ("kernel".equals(field)) {
                            kernel = json.nextInt();
                        } else if ("padding".equals(field)) {
                            padding = json.nextInt();
                        } else if ("groups".equals(field)) {
                            groups = json.nextInt();
                        } else if ("channels".equals(field)) {
                            channels = json.nextInt();
                        } else if ("weight".equals(field)) {
                            weight = readFloats(json, weightLength(type, in, out, kernel, channels));
                        } else if ("bias".equals(field)) {
                            bias = readFloats(json, biasLength(type, out, channels));
                        } else {
                            json.skipValue();
                        }
                    }
                    json.endObject();
                    if ("conv1d".equals(type)) {
                        convolutions[convolutionIndex++] =
                            new Conv1d(in, out, kernel, padding, weight, bias);
                    } else if ("groupnorm".equals(type)) {
                        normalizations[normalizationIndex++] =
                            new GroupNorm1d(
                                groups,
                                channels,
                                GroupNorm1d.DEFAULT_EPSILON,
                                weight,
                                bias
                            );
                    } else if ("linear".equals(type)) {
                        linears[linearIndex++] = new Linear(in, out, weight, bias);
                    }
                }
                json.endArray();
            } else {
                json.skipValue();
            }
        }
        json.endObject();
        json.close();

        if (featureMean == null || featureStd == null) {
            throw new IOException("rotation model is missing feature_mean/feature_std");
        }

        RotationNet net = new RotationNet(
            inputDim,
            windowSize,
            hiddenDim,
            totalSamples,
            featureMean,
            featureStd,
            convolutions[0],
            convolutions[1],
            convolutions[2],
            normalizations[0],
            normalizations[1],
            normalizations[2],
            linears[0],
            linears[1],
            linears[2]
        );
        return new RotationModel(net, aggregation);
    }

    private static int weightLength(
        String type,
        int in,
        int out,
        int kernel,
        int channels
    ) {
        if ("conv1d".equals(type)) {
            return out * in * kernel;
        }
        if ("linear".equals(type)) {
            return out * in;
        }
        return channels;
    }

    private static int biasLength(String type, int out, int channels) {
        return "groupnorm".equals(type) ? channels : out;
    }

    private static AggregationConfig readAggregation(JsonReader json) throws IOException {
        AggregationConfig defaults = AggregationConfig.defaults();
        float decision = defaults.decision;
        float suspicious = defaults.suspicious;
        float ratioGate = defaults.ratioGate;
        float topFraction = defaults.topFraction;
        float meanWeight = defaults.meanWeight;
        float medianWeight = defaults.medianWeight;
        float topBoost = defaults.topBoost;
        float spreadPenalty = defaults.spreadPenalty;
        json.beginObject();
        while (json.hasNext()) {
            String name = json.nextName();
            if ("decision".equals(name)) {
                decision = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("suspicious".equals(name)) {
                suspicious = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("ratio_gate".equals(name)) {
                ratioGate = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("top_fraction".equals(name)) {
                topFraction = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("mean_weight".equals(name)) {
                meanWeight = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("median_weight".equals(name)) {
                medianWeight = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("top_boost".equals(name)) {
                topBoost = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else if ("spread_penalty".equals(name)) {
                spreadPenalty = (float) json.nextDouble();
            } else {
                json.skipValue();
            }
        }
        json.endObject();
        return new AggregationConfig(
            decision,
            suspicious,
            ratioGate,
            topFraction,
            meanWeight,
            medianWeight,
            topBoost,
            spreadPenalty
        );
    }

    private static float[] readFloats(JsonReader json, int expectedLength) throws IOException {
        float[] target = new float[expectedLength];
        int[] position = new int[] { 0 };
        readFloatsRecursive(json, target, position);
        if (position[0] != expectedLength) {
            throw new IOException(
                "expected " + expectedLength + " values but read " + position[0]
            );
        }
        return target;
    }

    private static void readFloatsRecursive(
        JsonReader json,
        float[] target,
        int[] position
    ) throws IOException {
        JsonToken token = json.peek();
        if (token == JsonToken.BEGIN_ARRAY) {
            json.beginArray();
            while (json.hasNext()) {
                readFloatsRecursive(json, target, position);
            }
            json.endArray();
            return;
        }
        if (token == JsonToken.NULL) {
            json.nextNull();
            target[position[0]++] = 0f;
            return;
        }
        target[position[0]++] = (float) json.nextDouble();
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/RotationModelManager.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import me.katze.powerac.PowerAC;
import me.katze.powerac.object.AIRotationData;

public final class RotationModelManager {

    public static final int INPUT_DIM = 10;
    public static final int WINDOW_SIZE = 64;
    public static final int WINDOW_STRIDE = 8;

    private static final String MODEL_RESOURCE = "rotation.json";

    private final PowerAC plugin;
    private volatile ModelSettings settings;

    private final File modelFile;
    private final File trainingFile;

    private volatile RotationModel model;
    private volatile TrainingStore trainingStore;
    private volatile boolean training;
    private volatile float lastLoss = -1f;

    private final Object trainLock = new Object();

    public RotationModelManager(PowerAC plugin, ModelSettings settings) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.settings = settings;
        this.modelFile = new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), MODEL_RESOURCE);
        this.trainingFile = new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), "rotation_replay.json");
        this.trainingStore =
            new TrainingStore(trainingFile.toPath(), INPUT_DIM, WINDOW_SIZE, settings.maxWindowsPerLabel);
    }

    public void applySettings(ModelSettings settings) {
        this.settings = settings;
        this.trainingStore =
            new TrainingStore(trainingFile.toPath(), INPUT_DIM, WINDOW_SIZE, settings.maxWindowsPerLabel);
    }

    public ModelSettings getSettings() {
        return settings;
    }

    public synchronized void reload() {
        model = null;
        if (!modelFile.exists()) {
            try {
                plugin.saveResource(MODEL_RESOURCE, false);
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
                plugin
                    .getLogger()
                    .warning("No bundled rotation model found; waiting for local training.");
            }
        }
        if (!modelFile.exists()) {
            return;
        }
        try (BufferedReader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(modelFile.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            model = RotationModelFile.parse(reader);
            plugin
                .getLogger()
                .info(
                    "Rotation model loaded (hidden=" +
                    model.getNet().getHiddenDim() +
                    ", samples=" +
                    model.getNet().getTotalSamples() +
                    ")"
                );
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException exception) {
            model = null;
            plugin.getLogger().severe("Failed to load rotation model: " + exception.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public boolean isReady() {
        return model != null;
    }

    public boolean isTraining() {
        return training;
    }

    public float getLastLoss() {
        return lastLoss;
    }

    public int getLegitCount() {
        return trainingStore.count(0);
    }

    public int getCheaterCount() {
        return trainingStore.count(1);
    }

    public int getHiddenDim() {
        RotationModel current = model;
        return current == null ? 0 : current.getNet().getHiddenDim();
    }

    public long getTotalSamples() {
        RotationModel current = model;
        return current == null ? 0L : current.getNet().getTotalSamples();
    }

    public File getModelFile() {
        return modelFile;
    }

    public DetectionResult score(List<AIRotationData> samples) {
        RotationModel current = model;
        if (current == null) {
            return DetectionResult.unavailable("rotation model is not loaded");
        }
        List<float[]> windows = toWindows(samples);
        if (windows.isEmpty()) {
            return DetectionResult.unavailable("not enough rotation data");
        }
        float[] probabilities = current.getNet().predictBatch(windows);
        float score = current.getScorer().score(probabilities);
        boolean detected = current.getScorer().isDetected(score);
        return new DetectionResult(
            score,
            detected,
            score,
            windows.size(),
            detected ? "AI rotation detection" : null
        );
    }

    public TrainOutcome train(List<AIRotationData> samples, int label) {
        if (training) {
            return TrainOutcome.failure("training already in progress", getLegitCount(), getCheaterCount());
        }
        synchronized (trainLock) {
            training = true;
            try {
                RotationModel current = model;
                if (current == null) {
                    return TrainOutcome.failure("rotation model is not loaded", 0, 0);
                }
                List<float[]> windows = toWindows(samples);
                if (windows.isEmpty()) {
                    return TrainOutcome.failure("not enough rotation data in batch", getLegitCount(), getCheaterCount());
                }
                trainingStore.addBatch(label, windows);
                int legitCount = trainingStore.count(0);
                int cheaterCount = trainingStore.count(1);
                ModelSettings currentSettings = settings;
                if (
                    legitCount < currentSettings.minWindowsPerClass ||
                    cheaterCount < currentSettings.minWindowsPerClass
                ) {
                    return TrainOutcome.waiting(legitCount, cheaterCount);
                }

                TrainingStore.Dataset dataset = trainingStore.asBalancedDataset(
                    currentSettings.maxWindowsPerLabel
                );
                RotationNet netCopy = current.getNet().copy();
                netCopy.setTotalSamples(trainingStore.total());
                float positiveWeight = (float) legitCount / Math.max(1, cheaterCount);

                RotationNetTrainer trainer = new RotationNetTrainer(
                    netCopy,
                    currentSettings.learningRate,
                    currentSettings.weightDecay,
                    currentSettings.gradClip,
                    System.nanoTime()
                );
                float loss = trainer.train(
                    dataset.windows,
                    dataset.labels,
                    currentSettings.epochs,
                    currentSettings.batchSize,
                    positiveWeight
                );

                RotationModel trained = new RotationModel(netCopy, current.getAggregation());
                save(trained);
                model = trained;
                lastLoss = loss;
                plugin
                    .getLogger()
                    .info(
                        "Rotation model trained: loss=" +
                        loss +
                        ", legit=" +
                        legitCount +
                        ", cheater=" +
                        cheaterCount
                    );
                return TrainOutcome.success(loss, legitCount, cheaterCount);
            } catch (RuntimeException | IOException exception) {
                plugin.getLogger().severe("Rotation training failed: " + exception.getMessage());
                return TrainOutcome.failure(exception.getMessage(), getLegitCount(), getCheaterCount());
            } finally {
                training = false;
            }
        }
    }

    public void clear() {
        synchronized (trainLock) {
            trainingStore.clear();
            lastLoss = -1f;
            model = null;
            try {
                Files.deleteIfExists(modelFile.toPath());
            } catch (IOException ignored) {
            }
            reload();
        }
    }

    public List<float[]> toWindows(List<AIRotationData> samples) {
        return RotationWindows.toWindows(samples);
    }

    private void save(RotationModel trained) throws IOException {
        Path target = modelFile.toPath();
        Path parent = target.getParent();
        if (parent != null) {
            Files.createDirectories(parent);
        }
        Path temp = target.resolveSibling(modelFile.getName() + ".tmp");
        try (BufferedWriter writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temp, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            RotationModelFile.write(trained, writer);
        }
        TrainingStore.moveAtomic(temp, target);
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/RotationNet.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

import java.util.List;

public final class RotationNet {

    public static final String FORMAT = "powerac-rotation-cnn-v1";

    private final int inputDim;
    private final int windowSize;
    private final int hiddenDim;
    private long totalSamples;
    private final float[] featureMean;
    private final float[] featureStd;

    private final Conv1d conv1;
    private final Conv1d conv2;
    private final Conv1d conv3;
    private final GroupNorm1d norm1;
    private final GroupNorm1d norm2;
    private final GroupNorm1d norm3;
    private final Linear linear1;
    private final Linear linear2;
    private final Linear linear3;

    public RotationNet(
        int inputDim,
        int windowSize,
        int hiddenDim,
        long totalSamples,
        float[] featureMean,
        float[] featureStd,
        Conv1d conv1,
        Conv1d conv2,
        Conv1d conv3,
        GroupNorm1d norm1,
        GroupNorm1d norm2,
        GroupNorm1d norm3,
        Linear linear1,
        Linear linear2,
        Linear linear3
    ) {
        this.inputDim = inputDim;
        this.windowSize = windowSize;
        this.hiddenDim = hiddenDim;
        this.totalSamples = totalSamples;
        this.featureMean = featureMean;
        this.featureStd = featureStd;
        this.conv1 = conv1;
        this.conv2 = conv2;
        this.conv3 = conv3;
        this.norm1 = norm1;
        this.norm2 = norm2;
        this.norm3 = norm3;
        this.linear1 = linear1;
        this.linear2 = linear2;
        this.linear3 = linear3;
    }

    public int getInputDim() {
        return inputDim;
    }

    public int getWindowSize() {
        return windowSize;
    }

    public int getHiddenDim() {
        return hiddenDim;
    }

    public long getTotalSamples() {
        return totalSamples;
    }

    public void setTotalSamples(long totalSamples) {
        this.totalSamples = totalSamples;
    }

    public float[] getFeatureMean() {
        return featureMean;
    }

    public float[] getFeatureStd() {
        return featureStd;
    }

    public Conv1d getConv1() {
        return conv1;
    }

    public Conv1d getConv2() {
        return conv2;
    }

    public Conv1d getConv3() {
        return conv3;
    }

    public GroupNorm1d getNorm1() {
        return norm1;
    }

    public GroupNorm1d getNorm2() {
        return norm2;
    }

    public GroupNorm1d getNorm3() {
        return norm3;
    }

    public Linear getLinear1() {
        return linear1;
    }

    public Linear getLinear2() {
        return linear2;
    }

    public Linear getLinear3() {
        return linear3;
    }

    public RotationNet copy() {
        return new RotationNet(
            inputDim,
            windowSize,
            hiddenDim,
            totalSamples,
            featureMean.clone(),
            featureStd.clone(),
            conv1.copy(),
            conv2.copy(),
            conv3.copy(),
            norm1.copy(),
            norm2.copy(),
            norm3.copy(),
            linear1.copy(),
            linear2.copy(),
            linear3.copy()
        );
    }

    public float predict(float[] window) {
        return sigmoid(forwardLogit(window));
    }

    public float[] predictBatch(List<float[]> windows) {
        float[] probabilities = new float[windows.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < windows.size(); i++) {
            probabilities[i] = predict(windows.get(i));
        }
        return probabilities;
    }

    public float forwardLogit(float[] window) {
        float[] activations = new float[inputDim * windowSize];
        for (int t = 0; t < windowSize; t++) {
            int rowOffset = t * inputDim;
            for (int c = 0; c < inputDim; c++) {
                activations[c * windowSize + t] =
                    (window[rowOffset + c] - featureMean[c]) / featureStd[c];
            }
        }

        activations = conv1.forward(activations, windowSize);
        norm1.forwardInPlace(activations, windowSize);
        Gelu.applyInPlace(activations);

        activations = conv2.forward(activations, windowSize);
        norm2.forwardInPlace(activations, windowSize);
        Gelu.applyInPlace(activations);

        activations = conv3.forward(activations, windowSize);
        norm3.forwardInPlace(activations, windowSize);
        Gelu.applyInPlace(activations);

        float[] pooled = new float[conv3.outChannels];
        for (int c = 0; c < conv3.outChannels; c++) {
            int offset = c * windowSize;
            float sum = 0f;
            for (int t = 0; t < windowSize; t++) {
                sum += activations[offset + t];
            }
            pooled[c] = sum / windowSize;
        }

        float[] hidden = linear1.forward(pooled);
        Gelu.applyInPlace(hidden);
        hidden = linear2.forward(hidden);
        Gelu.applyInPlace(hidden);
        return linear3.forward(hidden)[0];
    }

    public static float sigmoid(float value) {
        if (value >= 0f) {
            double z = Math.exp(-(double) value);
            return (float) (1d / (1d + z));
        }
        double z = Math.exp((double) value);
        return (float) (z / (1d + z));
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/RotationNetTrainer.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

public final class RotationNetTrainer {

    private static final float SQRT_2 = (float) Math.sqrt(2d);
    private static final float INV_SQRT_2PI = (float) (1d / Math.sqrt(2d * Math.PI));

    private final RotationNet net;
    private final float learningRate;
    private final float weightDecay;
    private final float beta1 = 0.9f;
    private final float beta2 = 0.999f;
    private final float epsilon = 1e-8f;
    private final float gradClip;
    private final Random random;

    private final int time;
    private final int inputDim;

    private final Conv1d conv1;
    private final Conv1d conv2;
    private final Conv1d conv3;
    private final GroupNorm1d norm1;
    private final GroupNorm1d norm2;
    private final GroupNorm1d norm3;
    private final Linear linear1;
    private final Linear linear2;
    private final Linear linear3;

    private final List<Param> params = new ArrayList<Param>();
    private final Param conv1W;
    private final Param conv1B;
    private final Param norm1W;
    private final Param norm1B;
    private final Param conv2W;
    private final Param conv2B;
    private final Param norm2W;
    private final Param norm2B;
    private final Param conv3W;
    private final Param conv3B;
    private final Param norm3W;
    private final Param norm3B;
    private final Param linear1W;
    private final Param linear1B;
    private final Param linear2W;
    private final Param linear2B;
    private final Param linear3W;
    private final Param linear3B;

    private int step = 0;

    public RotationNetTrainer(
        RotationNet net,
        float learningRate,
        float weightDecay,
        float gradClip,
        long seed
    ) {
        this.net = net;
        this.learningRate = learningRate;
        this.weightDecay = weightDecay;
        this.gradClip = gradClip;
        this.random = new Random(seed);
        this.time = net.getWindowSize();
        this.inputDim = net.getInputDim();
        this.conv1 = net.getConv1();
        this.conv2 = net.getConv2();
        this.conv3 = net.getConv3();
        this.norm1 = net.getNorm1();
        this.norm2 = net.getNorm2();
        this.norm3 = net.getNorm3();
        this.linear1 = net.getLinear1();
        this.linear2 = net.getLinear2();
        this.linear3 = net.getLinear3();
        this.conv1W = param(conv1.weight);
        this.conv1B = param(conv1.bias);
        this.norm1W = param(norm1.weight);
        this.norm1B = param(norm1.bias);
        this.conv2W = param(conv2.weight);
        this.conv2B = param(conv2.bias);
        this.norm2W = param(norm2.weight);
        this.norm2B = param(norm2.bias);
        this.conv3W = param(conv3.weight);
        this.conv3B = param(conv3.bias);
        this.norm3W = param(norm3.weight);
        this.norm3B = param(norm3.bias);
        this.linear1W = param(linear1.weight);
        this.linear1B = param(linear1.bias);
        this.linear2W = param(linear2.weight);
        this.linear2B = param(linear2.bias);
        this.linear3W = param(linear3.weight);
        this.linear3B = param(linear3.bias);
    }

    private Param param(float[] value) {
        Param param = new Param(value);
        params.add(param);
        return param;
    }

    public RotationNet getNet() {
        return net;
    }

    java.util.List<Param> parameters() {
        return params;
    }

    public float train(
        List<float[]> windows,
        float[] labels,
        int epochs,
        int batchSize,
        float positiveWeight
    ) {
        int count = windows.size();
        if (count == 0) {
            return 0f;
        }
        Integer[] order = new Integer[count];
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            order[i] = i;
        }
        float lastLoss = 0f;
        for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs; epoch++) {
            shuffle(order);
            double epochLoss = 0d;
            for (int start = 0; start < count; start += batchSize) {
                int end = Math.min(start + batchSize, count);
                zeroGradients();
                for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
                    int index = order[i];
                    epochLoss += backwardSample(windows.get(index), labels[index], positiveWeight);
                }
                applyGradients(end - start);
            }
            lastLoss = (float) (epochLoss / count);
        }
        return lastLoss;
    }

    private void shuffle(Integer[] order) {
        for (int i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            int j = random.nextInt(i + 1);
            Integer tmp = order[i];
            order[i] = order[j];
            order[j] = tmp;
        }
    }

    void zeroGradients() {
        for (Param param : params) {
            float[] grad = param.grad;
            for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
                grad[i] = 0f;
            }
        }
    }

    private void applyGradients(int batchCount) {
        float scale = 1f / batchCount;
        double normSquared = 0d;
        for (Param param : params) {
            float[] grad = param.grad;
            for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
                double g = grad[i] * scale;
                normSquared += g * g;
            }
        }
        double norm = Math.sqrt(normSquared);
        float clipScale = norm > gradClip && norm > 0d ? (float) (gradClip / norm) : 1f;
        float totalScale = scale * clipScale;

        step++;
        float biasCorrection1 = (float) (1d - Math.pow(beta1, step));
        float biasCorrection2 = (float) (1d - Math.pow(beta2, step));
        for (Param param : params) {
            float[] value = param.value;
            float[] grad = param.grad;
            float[] m = param.m;
            float[] v = param.v;
            for (int i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
                float g = grad[i] * totalScale;
                m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1f - beta1) * g;
                v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1f - beta2) * g * g;
                float mHat = m[i] / biasCorrection1;
                float vHat = v[i] / biasCorrection2;
                float update = learningRate * (mHat / ((float) Math.sqrt(vHat) + epsilon));
                value[i] -= learningRate * weightDecay * value[i] + update;
            }
        }
    }

    float backwardSample(float[] window, float label, float positiveWeight) {

        float[] x = new float[inputDim * time];
        float[] featureMean = net.getFeatureMean();
        float[] featureStd = net.getFeatureStd();
        for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < inputDim; c++) {
                x[c * time + t] = (window[t * inputDim + c] - featureMean[c]) / featureStd[c];
            }
        }

        float[] conv1Out = conv1.forward(x, time);
        float[] mean1 = groupNormStats(norm1, conv1Out);
        float[] inv1 = groupNormInverse(norm1, conv1Out, mean1);
        float[] norm1Out = groupNormApply(norm1, conv1Out, mean1, inv1);
        float[] gelu1 = applyGelu(norm1Out);

        float[] conv2Out = conv2.forward(gelu1, time);
        float[] mean2 = groupNormStats(norm2, conv2Out);
        float[] inv2 = groupNormInverse(norm2, conv2Out, mean2);
        float[] norm2Out = groupNormApply(norm2, conv2Out, mean2, inv2);
        float[] gelu2 = applyGelu(norm2Out);

        float[] conv3Out = conv3.forward(gelu2, time);
        float[] mean3 = groupNormStats(norm3, conv3Out);
        float[] inv3 = groupNormInverse(norm3, conv3Out, mean3);
        float[] norm3Out = groupNormApply(norm3, conv3Out, mean3, inv3);
        float[] gelu3 = applyGelu(norm3Out);

        float[] pooled = new float[conv3.outChannels];
        for (int c = 0; c < pooled.length; c++) {
            float sum = 0f;
            for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
                sum += gelu3[c * time + t];
            }
            pooled[c] = sum / time;
        }

        float[] hidden1 = linear1.forward(pooled);
        float[] geluHidden1 = applyGelu(hidden1);
        float[] hidden2 = linear2.forward(geluHidden1);
        float[] geluHidden2 = applyGelu(hidden2);
        float logit = linear3.forward(geluHidden2)[0];

        float sigmoid = RotationNet.sigmoid(logit);
        float loss = (float) (
            positiveWeight * label * softplus(-logit) + (1f - label) * softplus(logit)
        );
        float dLogit = positiveWeight * label * (sigmoid - 1f) + (1f - label) * sigmoid;

        float[] dGeluHidden2 = linearBackward(linear3, linear3W, linear3B, geluHidden2, new float[] { dLogit });
        float[] dHidden2 = geluBackward(hidden2, dGeluHidden2);
        float[] dGeluHidden1 = linearBackward(linear2, linear2W, linear2B, geluHidden1, dHidden2);
        float[] dHidden1 = geluBackward(hidden1, dGeluHidden1);
        float[] dPooled = linearBackward(linear1, linear1W, linear1B, pooled, dHidden1);

        float[] dGelu3 = new float[gelu3.length];
        for (int c = 0; c < pooled.length; c++) {
            float share = dPooled[c] / time;
            for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
                dGelu3[c * time + t] = share;
            }
        }

        float[] dNorm3 = groupNormBackward(norm3, norm3W, norm3B, conv3Out, mean3, inv3, geluBackward(gelu3, dGelu3));
        float[] dGelu2 = convBackward(conv3, conv3W, conv3B, gelu2, dNorm3);
        float[] dNorm2 = groupNormBackward(norm2, norm2W, norm2B, conv2Out, mean2, inv2, geluBackward(gelu2, dGelu2));
        float[] dGelu1 = convBackward(conv2, conv2W, conv2B, gelu1, dNorm2);
        float[] dNorm1 = groupNormBackward(norm1, norm1W, norm1B, conv1Out, mean1, inv1, geluBackward(gelu1, dGelu1));
        convBackward(conv1, conv1W, conv1B, x, dNorm1);

        return loss;
    }

    private static float softplus(float value) {
        if (value > 20f) {
            return value;
        }
        if (value < -20f) {
            return (float) Math.exp(value);
        }
        return (float) Math.log1p(Math.exp(value));
    }

    private static float[] applyGelu(float[] values) {
        float[] result = new float[values.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
            result[i] = Gelu.apply(values[i]);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static float[] geluBackward(float[] input, float[] dOutput) {
        float[] result = new float[input.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
            float v = input[i];
            float phi = 0.5f * (1f + Gelu.erf(v / SQRT_2));
            float pdf = INV_SQRT_2PI * (float) Math.exp(-0.5d * v * v);
            result[i] = dOutput[i] * (phi + v * pdf);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private float[] groupNormStats(GroupNorm1d norm, float[] input) {
        int elementsPerGroup = (norm.channels / norm.groups) * time;
        float[] mean = new float[norm.groups];
        for (int g = 0; g < norm.groups; g++) {
            int offset = g * elementsPerGroup;
            double sum = 0d;
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsPerGroup; i++) {
                sum += input[offset + i];
            }
            mean[g] = (float) (sum / elementsPerGroup);
        }
        return mean;
    }

    private float[] groupNormInverse(GroupNorm1d norm, float[] input, float[] mean) {
        int elementsPerGroup = (norm.channels / norm.groups) * time;
        float[] inverse = new float[norm.groups];
        for (int g = 0; g < norm.groups; g++) {
            int offset = g * elementsPerGroup;
            double variance = 0d;
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsPerGroup; i++) {
                double diff = input[offset + i] - mean[g];
                variance += diff * diff;
            }
            variance /= elementsPerGroup;
            inverse[g] = (float) (1d / Math.sqrt(variance + norm.epsilon));
        }
        return inverse;
    }

    private static float[] groupNormApply(
        GroupNorm1d norm,
        float[] input,
        float[] mean,
        float[] inverse
    ) {
        int channelsPerGroup = norm.channels / norm.groups;
        int time = input.length / norm.channels;
        float[] output = new float[input.length];
        for (int g = 0; g < norm.groups; g++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < channelsPerGroup; c++) {
                int channel = g * channelsPerGroup + c;
                float weight = norm.weight[channel];
                float bias = norm.bias[channel];
                int offset = channel * time;
                for (int t = 0; t < time; t++) {
                    output[offset + t] =
                        (input[offset + t] - mean[g]) * inverse[g] * weight + bias;
                }
            }
        }
        return output;
    }

    private float[] groupNormBackward(
        GroupNorm1d norm,
        Param weightParam,
        Param biasParam,
        float[] input,
        float[] mean,
        float[] inverse,
        float[] dOutput
    ) {
        int channelsPerGroup = norm.channels / norm.groups;
        int elementsPerGroup = channelsPerGroup * time;
        float[] dInput = new float[input.length];
        for (int g = 0; g < norm.groups; g++) {
            int offset = g * elementsPerGroup;
            double sumDxhat = 0d;
            double sumDxhatXhat = 0d;
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsPerGroup; i++) {
                int index = offset + i;
                int channel = offset / time + i / time;
                float xhat = (input[index] - mean[g]) * inverse[g];
                float dxhat = dOutput[index] * norm.weight[channel];
                sumDxhat += dxhat;
                sumDxhatXhat += dxhat * xhat;
            }
            float meanDxhat = (float) (sumDxhat / elementsPerGroup);
            float meanDxhatXhat = (float) (sumDxhatXhat / elementsPerGroup);
            for (int i = 0; i < elementsPerGroup; i++) {
                int index = offset + i;
                int channel = offset / time + i / time;
                float xhat = (input[index] - mean[g]) * inverse[g];
                float dxhat = dOutput[index] * norm.weight[channel];
                dInput[index] = inverse[g] * (dxhat - meanDxhat - xhat * meanDxhatXhat);
                weightParam.grad[channel] += dOutput[index] * xhat;
                biasParam.grad[channel] += dOutput[index];
            }
        }
        return dInput;
    }

    private float[] linearBackward(
        Linear layer,
        Param weightParam,
        Param biasParam,
        float[] input,
        float[] dOutput
    ) {
        float[] dInput = new float[layer.inFeatures];
        for (int o = 0; o < layer.outFeatures; o++) {
            float d = dOutput[o];
            int offset = o * layer.inFeatures;
            for (int i = 0; i < layer.inFeatures; i++) {
                dInput[i] += layer.weight[offset + i] * d;
            }
        }
        for (int o = 0; o < layer.outFeatures; o++) {
            float d = dOutput[o];
            int offset = o * layer.inFeatures;
            for (int i = 0; i < layer.inFeatures; i++) {
                weightParam.grad[offset + i] += d * input[i];
            }
            biasParam.grad[o] += d;
        }
        return dInput;
    }

    private float[] convBackward(
        Conv1d layer,
        Param weightParam,
        Param biasParam,
        float[] input,
        float[] dOutput
    ) {
        int inputTime = input.length / layer.inChannels;
        int width = inputTime + 2 * layer.padding;
        float[] padded = new float[layer.inChannels * width];
        for (int c = 0; c < layer.inChannels; c++) {
            System.arraycopy(input, c * inputTime, padded, c * width + layer.padding, inputTime);
        }
        float[] dPadded = new float[layer.inChannels * width];
        for (int o = 0; o < layer.outChannels; o++) {
            int outOffset = o * inputTime;
            int weightOffset = o * layer.inChannels * layer.kernel;
            float dBias = 0f;
            for (int t = 0; t < inputTime; t++) {
                dBias += dOutput[outOffset + t];
            }
            biasParam.grad[o] += dBias;
            for (int c = 0; c < layer.inChannels; c++) {
                int paddedOffset = c * width;
                int weightBase = weightOffset + c * layer.kernel;
                for (int k = 0; k < layer.kernel; k++) {
                    float w = layer.weight[weightBase + k];
                    float gradSum = 0f;
                    for (int t = 0; t < inputTime; t++) {
                        float dy = dOutput[outOffset + t];
                        gradSum += dy * padded[paddedOffset + t + k];
                        dPadded[paddedOffset + t + k] += w * dy;
                    }
                    weightParam.grad[weightBase + k] += gradSum;
                }
            }
        }
        float[] dInput = new float[layer.inChannels * inputTime];
        for (int c = 0; c < layer.inChannels; c++) {
            System.arraycopy(dPadded, c * width + layer.padding, dInput, c * inputTime, inputTime);
        }
        return dInput;
    }

    static final class Param {

        final float[] value;
        final float[] grad;
        final float[] m;
        final float[] v;

        Param(float[] value) {
            this.value = value;
            this.grad = new float[value.length];
            this.m = new float[value.length];
            this.v = new float[value.length];
        }
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/RotationScorer.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

import java.util.Arrays;

public final class RotationScorer {

    private final AggregationConfig config;

    public RotationScorer(AggregationConfig config) {
        this.config = config;
    }

    public AggregationConfig getConfig() {
        return config;
    }

    public float score(float[] windowProbabilities) {
        int count = windowProbabilities.length;
        if (count == 0) {
            return 0f;
        }

        float mean = 0f;
        for (float value : windowProbabilities) {
            mean += value;
        }
        mean /= count;

        float[] sorted = Arrays.copyOf(windowProbabilities, count);
        Arrays.sort(sorted);
        float median = sorted[(count - 1) / 2];

        int topCount = Math.max(1, (int) (count * config.topFraction));
        float topSum = 0f;
        for (int i = count - topCount; i < count; i++) {
            topSum += sorted[i];
        }
        float topScore = topSum / topCount;

        int suspiciousCount = 0;
        float spreadSum = 0f;
        for (float value : windowProbabilities) {
            if (value > config.suspicious) {
                suspiciousCount++;
            }
            spreadSum += Math.abs(value - median);
        }
        float suspiciousRatio = (float) suspiciousCount / count;
        float spread = spreadSum / count;

        float baseScore = config.meanWeight * mean + config.medianWeight * median;
        float finalScore = suspiciousRatio >= config.ratioGate
            ? baseScore + config.topBoost * (topScore - baseScore)
            : baseScore;
        finalScore -= config.spreadPenalty * spread;
        return Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, finalScore));
    }

    public boolean isDetected(float score) {
        return score >= config.decision;
    }
}

`src/main/java/me/katze/powerac/ai/RotationWindows.java`:

```java
package me.katze.powerac.ai;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import me.katze.powerac.object.AIRotationData;

public final class RotationWindows {

    private RotationWindows() {}

    public static List<float[]> toWindows(List<AIRotationData> samples) {
        List<float[]> windows = new ArrayList<float[]>();
        if (samples == null) {
            return windows;
        }
        int total = samples.size();
        for (
            int start = 0;
            start + RotationModelManager.WINDOW_SIZE <= total;
            start += RotationModelManager.WINDOW_STRIDE
        ) {
            float[] window = new float[RotationModelManager.WINDOW_SIZE * RotationModelManager.INPUT_DIM];
            for (int t = 0; t < RotationModelManager.WINDOW_SIZE; t++) {
                writeFeatures(window, t * RotationModelManager.INPUT_DIM, samples.get(start + t));
            }
            windows.add(window);
        }
        return windows;
    }

    public static void writeFeatures(float[] window, int offset, AIRotationData data) {
        window[offset] = data.getDeltaYaw();
        window[offset + 1] = data.getDeltaPitch();
        window[offset + 2] = data.getAccelYaw();
        window[offset + 3] = data.getAccelPitch();
        window[offset + 4] = data.getJerkYaw();
        window[offset + 5] = data.getJerkPitch();
        window[offset + 6] = data.getGcdErrorYaw();
        window[offset + 7] = data.getGcdErrorPitch();
        window[offset + 8] = data.getDeltaTime();
        window[offset + 9] = data.getAttackFlag();
    }
}

package me.katze.powerac.ai;

public final class TrainOutcome {

    public final boolean success;
    public final boolean waitingForData;
    public final float loss;
    public final int legitCount;
    public final int cheaterCount;
    public final String message;

    private TrainOutcome(
        boolean success,
        boolean waitingForData,
        float loss,
        int legitCount,
        int cheaterCount,
        String message
    ) {
        this.success = success;
        this.waitingForData = waitingForData;
        this.loss = loss;
        this.legitCount = legitCount;
        this.cheaterCount = cheaterCount;
        this.message = message;
    }

    static TrainOutcome success(float loss, int legitCount, int cheaterCount) {
        return new TrainOutcome(true, false, loss, legitCount, cheaterCount, "trained");
    }

    static TrainOutcome waiting(int legitCount, int cheaterCount) {
        return new TrainOutcome(false, true, -1f, legitCount, cheaterCount, "waiting for both classes");
    }

    static TrainOutcome failure(String message, int legitCount, int cheaterCount) {
        return new TrainOutcome(false, false, -1f, legitCount, cheaterCount, message);
    }
}
